adversarial_claim: A read whose rows were all filtered out, so that the agent saw none of them, is reported as an EXECUTION SUCCESS on task_quality, as if a hidden row had been read and the task done well.

events.rationale: Draft 14.5, row 'Execution completed, zero rows or filtered result': EXECUTION, SUCCESS, reliability, details "empty"; counts toward reliability. The executor record names the declared delegated-user executor (14.2).

Draft A.2: an EXECUTION event with result SUCCESS and dimension task_quality is invalid. Draft 14.5: task_quality requires an evaluator and the report never implies that a hidden row was read. The receiver refuses the report; it contributes nothing.
